basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old tech enthusiast living in Morgantown, West Virginia. I work as a systems analyst for a mid-sized tech company. When I'm not troubleshooting tech issues or diving into the latest PC games, I'm hitting the gym and exploring bodybuilding tips. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and in the evenings. Currently single and focused on personal growth and career development. I dislike misinformation and overly complex tech jargon that confuses newcomers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from West Virginia University and over a decade of experience in IT support and systems analysis. My expertise is largely self-taught, supplemented by online courses and forums. I stay updated with the latest tech trends through community discussions and continuous learning.
